plugin.name: Sandbox Sample
plugin.description: 示例沙箱插件：在 iframe 内演示宿主能力调用、实时事件回传与声明式面板渲染。

source: (function(){var rpc=window.__PluginRuntime;function render(res){var imgs=(res&&res.images)||[];rpc.renderPanel({title:'示例沙箱插件',description:'已读取画布节点/连线，并调用 AI 生成 '+imgs.length+' 张图片',image:imgs[0]||'',status:'done',actions:[{id:'regenerate',label:'再生成'}]});}function fail(e){rpc.renderPanel({title:'示例沙箱插件',description:'出错了：'+((e&&e.message)||e),status:'error'});}function run(){rpc.renderPanel({title:'示例沙箱插件',description:'正在生成…',status:'loading'});rpc.call('getNodes').then(function(){return rpc.call('getConnections');}).then(function(){return rpc.call('ai.generateImage',{prompt:'a small red circle on a white background'});}).then(render).catch(fail);}rpc.register('onPanelAction',function(p){if(p&&p.actionId==='regenerate'){return run();}});run();})();
